expected.note: text is trimmed; LyricFormat is PlainText and lines stays empty — the catalog relationship carries no timing, so no LRC/QRC parsing happens (musid-dli source_apple.rs LyricsProvider::lyrics)

none_cases.note: no song → None (not an error); upstream maps the same shape to Ok(None) via fetch_lyric → get_lyric turns None into FetchError::NotFound (voicefox apple/mod.rs:101-110), musid-dli returns Ok(None) directly
whitespace-only text is filtered to None (upstream api.rs:328-329)

capability_note: only plain-text lyrics exist in the unsigned catalog API; timed/syllable lyrics and translation require the media-user-token MusicKit surfaces, which neither upstream nor musid-dli implements (voicefox apple/api.rs:5 notes media-user-token is for personal libraries only; musid-dli implements no AuthenticationProvider login — login_status is always LoggedOut).
